dimensions.assessment: Affects federal banking agencies, the Department of the Treasury, and insured depository institutions and credit unions, particularly smaller community financial institutions.
dimensions.evidence: The Federal banking agencies, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, the Federal Trade Commission, the Bureau of Consumer Financial Protection, the Federal Communications Commission, and other appropriate Federal and State government agencies

dimensions.assessment: The primary requirement is an interagency study and report, alongside a voluntary pilot program, representing administrative and procedural changes for financial institutions.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 18 months after the date of enactment of this Act, the Federal banking agencies shall issue a report

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not specify explicit federal appropriations or direct revenue changes, though agencies must conduct studies and potentially run a pilot program.
Mandates a broad interagency study covering artificial intelligence, machine learning, payments system risks, and regulatory considerations, plus authorizes a temporary pilot program.
dimensions.evidence: establish a voluntary pilot program to facilitate community financial institution access for insured depository institutions and credit unions

dimensions.assessment: The study report is a one-time requirement, and any established pilot program must expire not later than 3 years after the report submission.
dimensions.evidence: Any pilot program established under this section shall expire not later than 3 years after submission of the report required under section 3(c).

missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budgetary allocations for conducting the study or running the pilot program.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs federal banking agencies to jointly study advanced fraud detection technologies and allows them to establish a voluntary pilot program for community financial institutions with assets under $10 billion.
